notes:
v1.2.3 — quitting APEX no longer stops cloud bots.

Bug: the QUIT button's teardown called stop_bot() on every running bot. For cloud bots that routed to POST /bots/{side}/stop on Oracle, killing them — defeating the whole point of running them on the cloud.

Fix: cloud bots are now skipped in the quit teardown. They live on Oracle and keep trading independent of the desktop. The quit-confirmation dialog also now clearly distinguishes the two: 'X local bots will stop · Y cloud bots will KEEP RUNNING on Oracle'.
